main.description: List indexed music events, soonest first. Without a time window only unexpired events are returned: those ending (or, with no end, starting) today or later, plus undated ones.

artist.description: Only events this artist plays: the artist's AT-URI, id or sha256.

did.description: Only events published by this repo.

rsvpBy.description: Only events this DID has RSVP'd to (going or interested).

kind.description: Only events of this kind (concert, festival...).

from.description: Only events that end at or after this time. Defaults to the start of today (UTC) when neither `to` nor `includePast` is given.

to.description: Only events that start at or before this time.

includePast.description: Return past events too, most recent first, instead of upcoming ones.

limit.description: The maximum number of events to return.
